admission.justification: Registering through the legacy names would work today and stop hearing every event after 2027-04-30, silently ending wake and activity tracking.

applicability: How the plugin registers its host-activity and turn events.
conditions: The host is Paseo 0.15 or later.
exclusions: The legacy server.on names, which work only until 2027-04-30.
statement: The plugin registers its events with the Paseo 0.15 hook names through server.addHook; the legacy server.on names stop working after 2027-04-30.
